title: 道富环球：30年期美债标售疲软，债市避险功能生变
speaker: Ben Lux

segments.en: Yeah, I don't think so I think I think the the 30-year weak auction reflects this I would say somewhat of an hour structural change where most investors are moving more towards shorter duration.
segments.zh: 我认为30年期美债标售疲软反映出一种结构性变化，多数投资者正转向更短久期。

segments.en: Okay, they're now a lot more worried or uncertain over what the new fed regime looks like right under Welsh and how that obviously unfolds.
segments.zh: 投资者对美联储新政策框架感到更加担忧或不确定，尤其是在新主席领导下将如何演变。

segments.en: But in general bonds are no longer acting as that safe havens in a more of a medium term basis. And what we're seeing is that investors have accepted those shocks.
segments.zh: 但总体而言，债券在中期内不再充当避险资产。我们看到投资者已接受这些冲击。

segments.en: But then they continue to buy in those dips actually.
segments.zh: 但他们实际上仍在逢低买入。
